cards.question: Which candidate was known for supporting and representing the 'common man'?
Who was the Speaker of the House accused of making a deal to secure the presidency for John Quincy Adams?
Who was the fourth major candidate in the election of 1824, alongside Jackson, Adams, and Clay?
Which candidate championed the 'American System' policy platform?
What key economic platform promoted a national bank, protective tariffs, and internal improvements?
In what year did the controversial election known as the 'Corrupt Bargain' take place?
How many major candidates ran for president in the 1824 election?
Which candidate received the most popular votes and electoral votes in 1824 but still failed to win the presidency?
Why was the election of 1824 sent to the House of Representatives to decide?
cards.answer: No candidate won a majority of the electoral votes.

cards.question: What type of taxes were placed on imported goods under the American System to protect U.S. businesses?
What was the 'Corrupt Bargain'?
cards.answer: The alleged deal between John Quincy Adams and Henry Clay to secure Adams the presidency.

cards.question: Who won the presidential election of 1824 after the House of Representatives voted?
What cabinet position did John Quincy Adams give Henry Clay after taking office?
Why did Andrew Jackson and his supporters believe the 1824 election was unfair?
cards.answer: They believed Adams and Clay made a secret deal to block Jackson from becoming president.

cards.question: Have historians conclusively proven that an actual corrupt deal took place between Adams and Clay?
cards.answer: No. It remains a political accusation and historic controversy rather than a proven agreement.

cards.question: Which government body is responsible for choosing the president when no candidate achieves an electoral majority?
Under constitutional rules, how many top electoral candidates can the House of Representatives choose from?
Which major candidate finished fourth in electoral votes and was automatically eliminated from the House vote?
Which Constitutional Amendment outlines the Contingent Election process used by the House in 1824?
Who officially became the 6th President of the United States as a result of the 1824 House vote?
How did Andrew Jackson's supporters react to the House vote outcome?
cards.answer: They reacted with outrage, accusing Adams and Clay of corruption and political theft.

cards.question: What major political party did Andrew Jackson and his supporters organize following the 1824 election?
Which president did Andrew Jackson defeat in the rematch election of 1828?
What was the outcome of the presidential election of 1828?
cards.answer: Andrew Jackson won a decisive victory over John Quincy Adams.

cards.question: What position did Henry Clay hold prior to his appointment as Secretary of State under President Adams?
cards.answer: Speaker of the House of Representatives
